description.p: MultiWall is a GTK4 application that allows you to set different wallpapers for each monitor in a multi-monitor setup. It supports various display modes (fill, fit, stretch, center, tile) and provides a real-time preview of your wallpaper configuration.

ul.li: Individual wallpaper configuration for each monitor
Multiple display modes (fill, fit, stretch, center, tile)
Light/Dark mode tab system: configure different wallpapers for each theme mode
Intelligent apply logic: applying from Light mode sets both modes, from Dark sets only dark
Auto-save per mode: configurations for both modes saved independently
More robust preview system with independent updates
